mechanics.claim: Playful makes Fizz untargetable while balanced on his trident, and the splash damage only lands after he hops off and becomes targetable again, delaying the damage instance relative to the cast.
mechanics.quote: dashes to the target location while becoming {{tip|untargetable}}, balancing on his trident for {{fd|0.75}} seconds ... becoming targetable and landing to create a splash that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Trickster detonates immediately on arrival in a smaller radius, dealing the same damage as Playful's splash but without the slow, and lands the damage sooner than waiting out Playful's full sequence.
mechanics.quote: hopping down and splashing onto the ground prematurely upon arrival to deal the same {{as|magic damage}} in a smaller radius but not applying the slow

mechanics.claim: Playful counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects like Spellblade, but detonating early into Trickster does not.
mechanics.quote:
''Playful'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Detonating the ability early for {{ai|Trickster|Fizz}} does not.

mechanics.claim: Trickster itself does not count as an ability activation.
mechanics.quote: ''Trickster'' does not count as an ability activation.

mechanics.claim: Playful cannot be used for about 0.5 seconds after using Urchin Strike, delaying the ability's availability but not its cooldown value.
mechanics.quote: ''Playful'' cannot be used for approximately {{fd|0.5}} seconds after using {{ai|Urchin Strike|Fizz}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown does not begin until after the post-effect (the splash) resolves.
